meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 它把项目完整的 claude-mem 时间线按 ISO 周拆成文件,再逐周依次派一个子代理,每个都接着上一周的 carry-forward 块继续写,产出每周一章的连续叙事摘要,存到 docs/timeline-weeks/ 下。
howto.when: 当你要求「weekly digests」「week-by-week story」「serial timeline」等,或想按周连载项目历史章节时触发;若只想要一份长篇报告应改用 timeline-report。

say.text: 给这个项目做 weekly digests,从开头写到结尾
say.note: 会按周依次生成每周一章的摘要

say.text: 续写下一周的 digest,接上上一章的 carry-forward
say.note: 只跑下一周,并沿用上周交接块

say.text: 重跑第 3 周的章节,用同一份 carry-forward
say.note: 会重试该周,不跳过链条

howto.what_en: Splits a project's full claude-mem timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one subagent per week in sequence — each gets the prior week's carry-forward block — producing one narrative chapter per ISO week.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline" or narrative chapters of a project's history; for one long report, use timeline-report instead.

say_en.text: Make weekly digests for this project from start to finish
say_en.note: Produces one chapter per ISO week

say_en.text: Continue with next week's digest, using the prior carry-forward
Retry week 3 with the same carry-forward
say_en.note: Reruns that week; the chain is not skipped
